architecture.text_paths: Context goes to cross-attention in every block; timestep-only AdaLN does not add a second text path. helper disables crossattn projection and uses no image context; minimal_v4_dit.py:1773-1788,1807-1815.
architecture.causal_timing: Each block has self-attention before cross-attention. Goal injected into carrier slot by block k can reach other slots in block k+1. This is not necessarily same-block self-attention mediation.

fixed_action_world_cut.operation: Zero the cross-attention output of every query row in all nine slots, all blocks. Self-attention stays intact.
zero_embedding_equivalence_derivation: For the verified configuration, text enters only cross-attention and there is no crossattn projection or extra image context.
V=Wv*context has no bias; with all-zero text V=0. K=0 after the bias-free projection and RMS normalization with epsilon.
For finite Q,K and nonempty context, attention(Q,K,V=0)=0. The output projection also has no bias, so its output is zero.
Therefore all-query post-projection cross-attention zeroing is functionally the same as a zero text embedding in this isolated forecast call. Identical noise and other inputs are required.
This derivation does not establish measured CUDA bitwise parity under every backend; no full-model parity experiment was run here.
fixed_action_world_cut.interpretation: Whole-forecast text removal / no-language ablation; do not rename as a selective Goal-Bus repair.
fixed_action_world_cut.matched_control_limit: An all-row text-edge cut exhausts all text edges, so there is no nontrivial same-size goal-preserving cross-attention control within this edge set.

old_goal_bus_cut.operation: Remove text cross-attention to observed and future slots; prevent those slots reading action and value via self-attention.
old_goal_bus_cut.confound: Also removes legitimate action-representation to future conditioning. Not a sound fixed-action world repair control.

world_text_only_cut.operation: Retain text cross-attention only at action slot; self-attention stays intact.
world_text_only_cut.interpretation: Tests whether the action slot can carry Goal in an artificially isolated network. Does not prove it is the sole mediator in the native system.

minimum_falsifiable_local_path_design.operation: Scope reversible hooks to forecast calls only. Zero only action-slot cross-attention outputs, all 28 blocks, leaving state/action self-attention and all other slots intact. Restore hooks before original-goal value and policy queries.
minimum_falsifiable_local_path_design.matched_budget: Each arm removes 196 query rows times all text positions times all heads times 28 blocks. Precommit both controls; no best-control selection.

minimum_falsifiable_local_path_design.allowed_claim: A conditional causal contribution of the selected path under this intervention if its effect differs from matched controls.

action_copy_interface.unproven_normative_contract: Execution equality does not by itself establish that the authors promised forecasts factor exclusively through decoded actions. Raw residuals could encode model-internal uncertainty or shared generative information; this audit does not establish intent or a formal factorization guarantee.
action_copy_interface.threat_model: Hypothetical write access to the intermediate raw action representation after proposal, before world prediction. No external attacker access, API Goal-to-alias control, or achievable natural attack has been demonstrated.

cpu_numeric_gate.reverse_failure: prefix_000 candidate_00: one coordinate differs by 1.4551915228366852e-11 after bounded correction; gate rejects it.
cpu_numeric_gate.interpretation: CPU canonical projection works for six candidates, reverse projection works for five. This does not authorize labeling all six as execution-equivalent or using CPU-gated tensors directly in CUDA inference.

minimum_next_gate: Load each committed raw latent and original normalized action on the actual inference device; verify original decoder equals the committed normalized tensor and unchanged physical controls using native inverse min-max.

Run project_action_slot on that device, with the same predefined bounds. Require exact equality of decoded actions and physical control arrays, unchanged other slots, no NaNs, and a changed representation. Reject failures without selecting by model outcomes.

Precommit Clean repeat, projected reverse alias where the gate passes, canonical projection of Clean, and canonical projection of alias. Keep original candidate controls in the executor; change forecast branch only. Explicitly distinguish exact tiled E(D(z)) from projected canonical tensors.

Hold original Goal, observation, complete 16 actions, prefix simulator state, future/value RNG, candidates, score rule and continuation policy fixed. Generate all predictions before reading replay outcomes.

Use independent same-state action replay for image/state consequences and original-goal fixed-policy continuation for true success and steps. Forecast divergence, value score changes and ranking flips alone are not damage.

Report clean canonicalization cost, deterministic repeat noise floor, alias error change, ranking change, and selected-action utility. If effects are negligible, retain a negative result; do not scale automatically.
action_copy_interface.canonicalization_caveat: To call the operation a canonical defense, alias and clean must produce identical canonical tensors, not merely equal decoded means. Floating-point correction can depend on the incoming representation. Gate this explicitly. A defense built from immutable committed action tensors is a trusted-interface rewrite, not an unchanged native model.

configs/world_model_wav_alias_screen.json contains a prior rejected WAV/MiniGrid action-alias generalization diagnostic; its recorded review judged novelty weak and no controller/attacker gate. Do not present action equivalence alone as a new security contribution.

conclusion.bus_cut: No privileged unique Goal-to-action-only bus exists in this native all-slot DiT. Full fixed-action cut is a no-language ablation; a local cut is a mechanism probe requiring matched controls and clean-cost measurement.
conclusion.copy_alias: The native action decoder discards redundant-copy residuals that the world receives, creating a precise interface to test. Exact CPU canonical projection exists for all six current candidates; execution-equivalent GPU aliases, prediction error and decision harm remain untested.
conclusion.causal_boundary: Changing physical query Goal does not alter a fixed full-state replay under identical controls and exogenous randomness. This interventional fact does not imply statistical conditional independence of future and Goal given partial observations, nor force a model to ignore all legitimate latent information.
